description_en: Modifies the name and description of an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 修改全球加速实例的名称和描述信息
name: ModifyGlobalAccelerationInstanceAttributes

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is located. 

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: global_acceleration_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.  

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的名称。  

长度为 2-128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，点号（.），下划线（_）和短横线（-）。但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.  

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的描述信息。  

长度为 2-256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description
